mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (month-over-month change > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25% and remains below this level for two consecutive months, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.25% for 2 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that accelerates economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate profit outlooks.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE decline) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, as measured by a negative average return in the interaction group compared to the control group.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes where housing starts exceed 600,000 units (HOUST > 600) and quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.0% (GDPC1 growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive 20-day forward returns due to strong consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 600 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is positive (month-over-month change > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% and remains elevated for three consecutive months, it signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL annual growth above 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the central bank is constrained from further easing and inflation erodes real returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual growth > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below $350,000 million, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 350.
